script: 你好！｜你好！你今天忙吗？｜不忙，我很高兴。
reading: Nǐ hǎo! | Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jīn tiān máng ma? | Bù máng, wǒ hěn gāo xìng.
english: Hello! | Hello! Are you busy today? | Not busy, I'm very happy.

script: 你好吗？｜我很好，你呢？｜我也很好。
reading: Nǐ hǎo ma? | Wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ne? | Wǒ yě hěn hǎo.
english: How are you? | I'm well, and you? | I'm well too.

script: 你是新同学吗？欢迎你！｜谢谢！我们做朋友吧！
reading: Nǐ shì xīn tóng xué ma? Huān yíng nǐ! | Xiè xie! Wǒ men zuò péng you ba!
english: Are you the new student? Welcome! | Thanks! Let's be friends!

script: 你好，你姓什么？｜我姓高，你呢？｜我姓白。
reading: Nǐ hǎo, nǐ xìng shén me? | Wǒ xìng gāo, nǐ ne? | Wǒ xìng bái.
english: Hello, what's your surname? | My surname is Gao, and yours? | My surname is Bai.

script: 你今天很高兴，为什么？｜因为今天是我的生日！
reading: Nǐ jīn tiān hěn gāo xìng, wèi shén me? | Yīn wèi jīn tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì!
english: You're very happy today, why? | Because today is my birthday!

script: 我们明天一起玩，好吗？｜好，太好了！
reading: Wǒ men míng tiān yì qǐ wán, hǎo ma? | Hǎo, tài hǎo le!
english: Let's play together tomorrow, okay? | Great, sounds good!

script: 你好！我可以介绍一下吗？｜可以，请介绍！
reading: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ kě yǐ jiè shào yí xià ma? | Kě yǐ, qǐng jiè shào!
english: Hello! May I introduce myself? | Sure, please go ahead!
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: 介绍一下 with no object and 请介绍 as a reply is not a natural exchange

script: 早上好！｜早上好！你几点起床的？｜我七点起床。
reading: Zǎo shang hǎo! | Zǎo shang hǎo! Nǐ jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng de? | Wǒ qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
english: Good morning! | Good morning! What time did you get up? | I got up at seven.

script: 你好，你今天要去哪儿？｜我要去学校，你呢？｜我要去商店。
reading: Nǐ hǎo, nǐ jīn tiān yào qù nǎr? | Wǒ yào qù xué xiào, nǐ ne? | Wǒ yào qù shāng diàn.
english: Hello, where are you going today? | I'm going to school, and you? | I'm going to the store.

script: 你好！你今天想做什么？｜我想去游泳，你呢？｜我想休息。
reading: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jīn tiān xiǎng zuò shén me? | Wǒ xiǎng qù yóu yǒng, nǐ ne? | Wǒ xiǎng xiū xi.
english: Hello! What do you want to do today? | I want to go swimming, and you? | I want to rest.

script: 你想吃什么？｜我想吃面条，你呢？｜我想吃鸡蛋。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng chī shén me? | Wǒ xiǎng chī miàn tiáo, nǐ ne? | Wǒ xiǎng chī jī dàn.
english: What do you want to eat? | I want to eat noodles, and you? | I want to eat eggs.

script: 这个面条好吃吗？｜非常好吃！你也吃一点儿吧。
reading: Zhè ge miàn tiáo hǎo chī ma? | Fēi cháng hǎo chī! Nǐ yě chī yì diǎnr ba.
english: Are these noodles tasty? | Very tasty! You have some too.

script: 你想喝咖啡还是牛奶？｜我想喝咖啡，谢谢。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng hē kā fēi hái shì niú nǎi? | Wǒ xiǎng hē kā fēi, xiè xie.
english: Do you want coffee or milk? | I'd like coffee, thanks.

script: 你觉得这个西瓜怎么样？｜很好吃，我很喜欢。
reading: Nǐ jué de zhè ge xī guā zěn me yàng? | Hěn hǎo chī, wǒ hěn xǐ huan.
english: What do you think of this watermelon? | It's tasty, I like it a lot.

script: 服务员，我要一个鸡蛋面。｜好的，请等一下。
reading: Fú wù yuán, wǒ yào yí gè jī dàn miàn. | Hǎo de, qǐng děng yí xià.
english: Waiter, I'd like an egg noodle dish. | Sure, please wait a moment.

script: 这个多少钱？｜很便宜，三块钱。｜太好了，我买一个。
reading: Zhè ge duō shao qián? | Hěn pián yi, sān kuài qián. | Tài hǎo le, wǒ mǎi yí gè.
english: How much is this? | It's cheap, three yuan. | Great, I'll buy one.

script: 这个苹果很贵。｜是的，但是很好吃。
reading: Zhè ge píng guǒ hěn guì. | Shì de, dàn shì hěn hǎo chī.
english: This apple is quite expensive. | Yeah, but it's very tasty.

script: 你在准备晚饭吗？｜是，我在做鸡蛋面。
reading: Nǐ zài zhǔn bèi wǎn fàn ma? | Shì, wǒ zài zuò jī dàn miàn.
english: Are you preparing dinner? | Yes, I'm making egg noodles.

script: 你已经吃饭了吗？｜还没有，我想现在吃。
reading: Nǐ yǐ jīng chī fàn le ma? | Hái méi yǒu, wǒ xiǎng xiàn zài chī.
english: Have you already eaten? | Not yet, I want to eat now.

script: 我们一起去饭店吃饭吧！｜好，我也想吃鱼。
reading: Wǒ men yì qǐ qù fàn diàn chī fàn ba! | Hǎo, wǒ yě xiǎng chī yú.
english: Let's go eat at a restaurant together! | Sure, I want to eat fish too.

script: 你吃过羊肉吗？｜吃过，很好吃，但是有点儿贵。
reading: Nǐ chī guo yáng ròu ma? | Chī guo, hěn hǎo chī, dàn shì yǒu diǎnr guì.
english: Have you had mutton before? | Yes, it's tasty, but a bit expensive.

script: 你觉得咖啡好喝吗？｜好喝，我很喜欢咖啡。
reading: Nǐ jué de kā fēi hǎo hē ma? | Hǎo hē, wǒ hěn xǐ huan kā fēi.
english: Do you think coffee tastes good? | It does, I really like coffee.

script: 今天天气怎么样？｜今天很晴，非常漂亮。
reading: Jīn tiān tiān qì zěn me yàng? | Jīn tiān hěn qíng, fēi cháng piào liang.
english: How's the weather today? | It's sunny today, really beautiful.
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: 非常漂亮 for weather is a calque of 'beautiful'

script: 明天会下雪吗？｜可能会，天气很冷。
reading: Míng tiān huì xià xuě ma? | Kě néng huì, tiān qì hěn lěng.
english: Will it snow tomorrow? | Maybe, it's very cold.

script: 今天是晴天还是阴天？｜是阴天，可能要下雨。
reading: Jīn tiān shì qíng tiān hái shì yīn tiān? | Shì yīn tiān, kě néng yào xià yǔ.
english: Is it sunny or cloudy today? | It's cloudy, it might rain.

script: 外面在下雪！｜真的吗？我们出去玩吧！
reading: Wài mian zài xià xuě! | Zhēn de ma? Wǒ men chū qù wán ba!
english: It's snowing outside! | Really? Let's go out and play!

script: 今天非常热，你热吗？｜我也很热，想去游泳。
reading: Jīn tiān fēi cháng rè, nǐ rè ma? | Wǒ yě hěn rè, xiǎng qù yóu yǒng.
english: It's extremely hot today, are you hot? | I'm hot too, I want to go swimming.

script: 现在天气怎么样？｜现在很冷，但是明天会晴。
reading: Xiàn zài tiān qì zěn me yàng? | Xiàn zài hěn lěng, dàn shì míng tiān huì qíng.
english: What's the weather like now? | It's cold now, but tomorrow will be sunny.

script: 下雨了，我们回家吧。｜好，我们等一下再走。
reading: Xià yǔ le, wǒ men huí jiā ba. | Hǎo, wǒ men děng yí xià zài zǒu.
english: It's raining, let's go home. | Okay, let's wait a bit and then go.

script: 今天天气真好！｜是的，我们一起去外面玩吧。
reading: Jīn tiān tiān qì zhēn hǎo! | Shì de, wǒ men yì qǐ qù wài mian wán ba.
english: The weather's really nice today! | Yeah, let's go outside and play together.

script: 你几点睡觉？｜我晚上十点睡觉，你呢？｜我十一点睡觉。
reading: Nǐ jǐ diǎn shuì jiào? | Wǒ wǎn shang shí diǎn shuì jiào, nǐ ne? | Wǒ shí yī diǎn shuì jiào.
english: What time do you go to sleep? | I go to sleep at ten in the evening, and you? | I go to sleep at eleven.

script: 你今天很累吗？｜非常累，我想早点休息。
reading: Nǐ jīn tiān hěn lèi ma? | Fēi cháng lèi, wǒ xiǎng zǎo diǎn xiū xi.
english: Are you very tired today? | Extremely tired, I want to rest a bit early.

script: 你几点起床？｜我早上七点起床。
reading: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng? | Wǒ zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
english: What time do you get up? | I get up at seven in the morning.

script: 你昨天晚上睡得好吗？｜睡得很好，我现在不累。
reading: Nǐ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì de hǎo ma? | Shuì de hěn hǎo, wǒ xiàn zài bú lèi.
english: Did you sleep well last night? | I slept really well, I'm not tired now.

script: 你昨天睡了几个小时？｜我睡了八个小时。
reading: Nǐ zuó tiān shuì le jǐ gè xiǎo shí? | Wǒ shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí.
english: How many hours did you sleep yesterday? | I slept for eight hours.

script: 你有哥哥吗？｜没有，但是我有一个弟弟和一个妹妹。
reading: Nǐ yǒu gē ge ma? | Méi yǒu, dàn shì wǒ yǒu yí gè dì di hé yí gè mèi mei.
english: Do you have an older brother? | No, but I have a younger brother and a younger sister.

script: 你姐姐做什么工作？｜她在一家公司上班。
reading: Nǐ jiě jie zuò shén me gōng zuò? | Tā zài yì jiā gōng sī shàng bān.
english: What does your older sister do for work? | She works at a company.

script: 你喜欢什么运动？｜我喜欢踢足球，你呢？｜我喜欢打篮球。
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan shén me yùn dòng? | Wǒ xǐ huan tī zú qiú, nǐ ne? | Wǒ xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú.
english: What sport do you like? | I like playing football, and you? | I like playing basketball.

script: 你每天跑步吗？｜是，我每天跑步，身体很好。
reading: Nǐ měi tiān pǎo bù ma? | Shì, wǒ měi tiān pǎo bù, shēn tǐ hěn hǎo.
english: Do you jog every day? | Yes, I jog every day, I'm very healthy.

script: 明天有考试吗？｜有，是汉语考试，我有点儿忙。
reading: Míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì ma? | Yǒu, shì hàn yǔ kǎo shì, wǒ yǒu diǎnr máng.
english: Is there an exam tomorrow? | Yes, a Chinese exam, I'm a bit busy.

script: 这个问题你懂吗？｜不懂，你可以告诉我吗？｜可以，我来帮助你。
reading: Zhè ge wèn tí nǐ dǒng ma? | Bù dǒng, nǐ kě yǐ gào su wǒ ma? | Kě yǐ, wǒ lái bāng zhù nǐ.
english: Do you understand this problem? | I don't, can you tell me? | Sure, I'll help you.

script: 老师问了一个问题，你回答了吗？｜回答了，但是我觉得我错了。
reading: Lǎo shī wèn le yí gè wèn tí, nǐ huí dá le ma? | Huí dá le, dàn shì wǒ jué de wǒ cuò le.
english: The teacher asked a question, did you answer it? | I did, but I think I got it wrong.

script: 你的手机在哪儿？｜在桌子上边。
reading: Nǐ de shǒu jī zài nǎr? | Zài zhuō zi shàng bian.
english: Where's your phone? | It's on the table.

script: 宾馆在哪儿？离这儿远吗？｜不远，很近，在你的右边。
reading: Bīn guǎn zài nǎr? Lí zhèr yuǎn ma? | Bù yuǎn, hěn jìn, zài nǐ de yòu bian.
english: Where's the hotel? Is it far from here? | Not far, it's close, on your right.

script: 机场怎么走？｜往前走，机场就在左边。
reading: Jī chǎng zěn me zǒu? | Wǎng qián zǒu, jī chǎng jiù zài zuǒ bian.
english: How do I get to the airport? | Go straight ahead, the airport is right on the left.

script: 这件衣服多少钱？｜不贵，很便宜。｜太好了，我买了。
reading: Zhè jiàn yī fu duō shao qián? | Bú guì, hěn pián yi. | Tài hǎo le, wǒ mǎi le.
english: How much is this piece of clothing? | Not expensive, it's cheap. | Great, I'll buy it.

script: 你想买铅笔吗？｜想，我也要买报纸。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng mǎi qiān bǐ ma? | Xiǎng, wǒ yě yào mǎi bào zhǐ.
english: Do you want to buy a pencil? | Yes, I also want to buy a newspaper.

script: 你去年去哪儿旅游了？｜我去年去了北京，非常漂亮。
reading: Nǐ qù nián qù nǎr lǚ yóu le? | Wǒ qù nián qù le běi jīng, fēi cháng piào liang.
english: Where did you travel last year? | I went to Beijing last year, it's very beautiful.

script: 飞机快到机场了吗？｜快到了，我们准备下飞机吧。
reading: Fēi jī kuài dào jī chǎng le ma? | Kuài dào le, wǒ men zhǔn bèi xià fēi jī ba.
english: Is the plane about to reach the airport? | Almost there, let's get ready to get off.

script: 你最喜欢什么颜色？｜我最喜欢红色，你呢？｜我喜欢黑色。
reading: Nǐ zuì xǐ huan shén me yán sè? | Wǒ zuì xǐ huan hóng sè, nǐ ne? | Wǒ xǐ huan hēi sè.
english: What's your favorite color? | I like red the most, and you? | I like black.

script: 你今天为什么不快乐？｜因为我的手表不见了。
reading: Nǐ jīn tiān wèi shén me bú kuài lè? | Yīn wèi wǒ de shǒu biǎo bú jiàn le.
english: Why aren't you happy today? | Because my watch is missing.

script: 你笑什么？｜我觉得今天很快乐。
reading: Nǐ xiào shén me? | Wǒ jué de jīn tiān hěn kuài lè.
english: What are you smiling about? | I just feel happy today.

script: 你怎么了？｜我可能生病了，身体不太好。
reading: Nǐ zěn me le? | Wǒ kě néng shēng bìng le, shēn tǐ bú tài hǎo.
english: What's wrong? | I might be sick, I'm not feeling well.

script: 你要去医院吗？｜要，我想买一点儿药。
reading: Nǐ yào qù yī yuàn ma? | Yào, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì diǎnr yào.
english: Are you going to the hospital? | Yes, I want to buy some medicine.

script: 你会跳舞吗？｜会一点儿，我也喜欢唱歌。
reading: Nǐ huì tiào wǔ ma? | Huì yì diǎnr, wǒ yě xǐ huan chàng gē.
english: Can you dance? | A little, I also like singing.

script: 公共汽车什么时候到？｜可能五分钟就到。
reading: Gōng gòng qì chē shén me shí hou dào? | Kě néng wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào.
english: When will the bus arrive? | It'll probably arrive in five minutes.

script: 他是你的丈夫吗？｜是，我们已经认识十年了。
reading: Tā shì nǐ de zhàng fu ma? | Shì, wǒ men yǐ jīng rèn shi shí nián le.
english: Is he your husband? | Yes, we've known each other for ten years already.

script: 她是你的妻子吗？｜是，她是一个很好的老师。
reading: Tā shì nǐ de qī zi ma? | Shì, tā shì yí gè hěn hǎo de lǎo shī.
english: Is she your wife? | Yes, she's a very good teacher.

script: 你在找什么？｜我在找我的手机，你看见了吗？｜没看见。
reading: Nǐ zài zhǎo shén me? | Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de shǒu jī, nǐ kàn jiàn le ma? | Méi kàn jiàn.
english: What are you looking for? | I'm looking for my phone, have you seen it? | No, I haven't.

script: 你正在做什么？｜我正在洗衣服，你呢？｜我在看报纸。
reading: Nǐ zhèng zài zuò shén me? | Wǒ zhèng zài xǐ yī fu, nǐ ne? | Wǒ zài kàn bào zhǐ.
english: What are you doing right now? | I'm washing clothes, and you? | I'm reading the newspaper.
